title: SafeScribe Solutions
text:
SafeScribe Solutions

notes:
Inbound from demo signup — marketing touchpoint: Sales Enablement pack. CTO (Alyssa Chen) on call. Small team building a lightweight call-summary widget embedded in CRMs. Main concern: PII in transcripts and how long Redwood retains audio/text. Quote: "We need to make sure customer phone numbers and credit card fragments are never stored in cleartext." Wants configurable retention windows and an easy purge API. Trial interest: Hosted API (self-serve) to start; likely to upgrade if can prove safe handling and cost < $0.002/token equivalent for summaries. SE demo focused on latency and redaction options. Prospect mentioned Fireflies today but said they need better control over retention and logs.

requirements_summary:
Workload: post-call summarization + searchable snippets for reps. Latency target: summary generation < 500ms p95 for short calls (<=5min). Throughput: initially low (50-200 calls/month), bursty. Cost sensitivity: high — SMB budget with expectation of predictable per-summary pricing. Model prefs: smaller, deterministic LLMs for summaries; open to Redwood-verified models. Routing: prefer single-region (us-east) hosted API. Must support programmatic purge and short retention windows (7-30 days).

pii_handling_notes:
Prefer client-side redaction/pseudonymization before sending — prospect exploring hybrid approach
Require automated entity redaction for phone, ssn, cc-like patterns
Need audit logs showing redaction/purge events
Would like examples for redact-then-summarize vs summarize-then-redact tradeoffs

blockers:
PII retention policy unclear
legal requests documented data residency options
needs clarity on audit log retention and access controls

next_step:
Send hosted API trial instructions + sample PII redaction guide; schedule 30m technical review

meeting_outcome:
Prospect will try hosted API free-tier for two weeks if provided redaction guide + sample curl commands. Legal to review data residency statement before proceeding.

timeline:
2026-02-20: inbound demo request via signup form
2026-02-24: initial discovery call w/ AE (Aria) + CTO Alyssa; high-level requirements
2026-03-02: technical deep-dive w/ SE (Miguel) — asked about redaction approaches
2026-03-05: sent security questionnaire (drive link)
2026-03-09: follow-up; requested sample tokenized redaction flow and retention SLA examples

communication_snippets:
AE note: send edited security FAQ + quickstart with redaction example
CTO quote on call: 'If we can't guarantee removal, we can't proceed'
SE action: prepare minimal demo repo showing client-side pseudonymization
